stories.title: Hold My DK is 6‑0 and owns zero picks in the next two drafts
stories.dek: TheMoneyTeam2302 went 5‑9 last year. This year he's undefeated, and he paid for it with the future.
body: Hold My DK is the only unbeaten team left. Six straight wins, 950.24 points, and a 51-15 all-play. Last year, as TheyLookedGoodInShorts, TheMoneyTeam2302 went 5-9. The year before, 5-9 again.

The roster is built to win right now. Christian McCaffrey (30), Derrick Henry (32), George Kittle (33), Patrick Mahomes (31) and Aaron Rodgers (42) are all starting. Rodgers is playing the superflex and has 124.68 points.

The cost: TheMoneyTeam2302 owns no picks in the first three rounds of the 2027 draft and none in 2028. His only pick in those rounds through 2029 is paknight12's 2029 third. If this team doesn't win a title in the next two years, there's no plan B.

Week 7 is Catfan94’s Farm Team, the third-best all-play team in the league. The Sportsbook has Hold My DK as a 6.5-point favorite. Tyler Warren, Brian Robinson Jr. and Rashee Rice are out, and Puka Nacua is questionable.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker is 2‑4, 9‑25 all time, and owns 11 first-round picks
stories.dek: The worst record in league history belongs to the guy who writes this website. So does the biggest pile of picks.
body: Let's get this out of the way: Bill_Buttlicker has never made the playoffs in this league. He went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025. He's 9-25 all time, the worst record of any current manager, and 2-4 this year with an 18-48 all-play.
Week 6 was a perfect example. He started Juwan Johnson in the flex (zero points) with Omar Cooper Jr. (20.3) and Jaylin Noel (20.2) on the bench, and lost 136.32 to 88.50.

Here's the other side. He owns five 2027 first-round picks (TJohn91's, jrsmith1391's, JAY2913's, paknight12's and Catfan94's), four 2028 firsts (his own, TJohn91's, Br0phy's and TheMoneyTeam2302's), and two 2029 firsts. That's 11 first-rounders in three drafts. His own 2027 first belongs to Br0phy, though, so the tank doesn't help him this year.
So what's the plan? Nobody knows. Bill_Buttlicker is not the commissioner here. He's just a guy with a website and a hoard of picks. Week 7 he's a 17.5-point dog to I Chase Brown Kids.

stories.title: 243.58: Catfan94 put up the highest score in league history on his own farm team
stories.dek: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Catfan94’s Farm Team by 127.22 in Week 5. The commish is not taking it easy on anyone.
body: In Week 5, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix scored 243.58, the highest score in Gentleman's Dynasty history by 45 points. The opponent was jrsmith1391's team, which is named Catfan94’s Farm Team. The farm team lost by 127.22.

Catfan94 is one of the league's commissioners, he lost last year's final at 12-2, and he has the best all-play record this year (52-14) along with the most points (970.94). Josh Allen (183.26) and Jahmyr Gibbs (159.2) are the best pair in the league.
The depth is silly, too. Catfan94 has Jordan Love, Michael Penix Jr. and Malik Willis behind Allen. In Week 6, Penix scored 28.1 on the bench.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 5-1 with one loss to Kraft for Cash. It's the real best team in the league, unbeaten or not. Week 7 is OBJAY as a 45.5-point favorite.

stories.title: The Champ won two straight titles, and is retooling on the fly
stories.dek: TJohn91 named his team The Champ and then won. Now he's 4‑2 with Lamar out and Davante Adams on IR.
body: TJohn91 won the title in 2024 as Dirty Mike & The Boys and again in 2025 as The Champ. He's 26-8 all time, the best record in the league, and one of its two commissioners.

He hasn't sat still. In Week 3 he sent Jameis Winston, Rashod Bateman, Javonte Williams, Brian Thomas Jr. and Cam Ward to ZachCarroll09 and a 2028 first for Tony Pollard, rookie Jeremiyah Love and a 2028 second. Javonte Williams has 107.5 points this season, for the other team now. He also bought Kayshon Boutte from Bill_Buttlicker for a 2029 second.
The quarterback room is deep: Jared Goff (135), Matthew Stafford (127.86) and Lamar Jackson, who's listed as out. The receivers are thinner with Davante Adams on IR.
4-2, 47-19 all-play, three straight wins. Week 7 he plays Kraft for Cash as a 6.5-point favorite. Bet against The Champ at your own risk.

feature.title: Week 6: Hold My DK survives, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte doesn't
body: Hold My DK beat Kraft for Cash 135.40 to 131.54 to stay unbeaten. Christian McCaffrey had 28.2 and Aaron Rodgers had 20.02 in the superflex. Chuba Hubbard's 22.1 sat on the bench. It was the closest game of the week, and TheMoneyTeam2302 keeps winning those.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix had the top score again, 155.04 over Asian Jim. Isaiah Likely had 25.9 in the flex and Jordan Love had 22.74 in the superflex. Michael Penix Jr. scored 28.1 on the bench.

Jefferson’s Reserve beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 136.32 to 88.50. Trevor Lawrence had 35.34 and C.J. Stroud had 28.98. Bill_Buttlicker got 30.3 from Drake Maye, zero from Juwan Johnson in the flex, and 40.5 from Omar Cooper Jr. and Jaylin Noel on the bench.
And Bourbon Lover scored 74.14, the low of the week, against OBJAY. Mark Andrews had 1.9 at tight end. paknight12 is 1-5.

columns.title: HOLD MY DK IS 6‑0 AND THE FUTURE IS A LIE
columns.dek: Zero picks in 2027. Zero picks in 2028. SIX WINS. I am losing my mind.
body: Six and oh. SIX AND OH. TheMoneyTeam2302 went 5-9 last year and 5-9 the year before, and now he's the last unbeaten team in Gentleman's Dynasty. Christian McCaffrey! Derrick Henry! Aaron Rodgers in the SUPERFLEX at 42 years old! Who does that? A MAN WITH NOTHING TO LOSE, THAT'S WHO!
And he has nothing to lose because HE HAS NO PICKS! None in the first three rounds of 2027! None in 2028! He traded the future for the present and the present is undefeated!
Is it sustainable? NO! His all-play is 51-15, second-best, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has more points! He won by 3.86 last week and 6.92 in Week 4! The close ones are going to flip eventually!
But TODAY? Today Hold My DK is 6-0 and every one of you is chasing him. RESPECT THE MORTGAGE!

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker, picks don't play on Sunday
columns.dek: Eleven first-round picks and a zero in the flex. Get serious.
body: I respect a rebuild. I don't respect a rebuild that forgets to set a lineup. In Week 6, Bill_Buttlicker started Juwan Johnson in the flex. Zero points. Omar Cooper Jr. scored 20.3 on the bench. Jaylin Noel scored 20.2 on the bench. He lost by 47.82.
This man is 9-25 all time. Zero playoff trips. 3-11, then 4-10, and now 2-4. And he's sitting on five 2027 firsts like they're going to walk onto the field.
Here's the thing about his tank: his own 2027 first belongs to Br0phy. Every loss this year helps somebody else. So there's no reason not to try.
Drake Maye has 136.52 points. Build around him. Use a couple of those firsts on players who are good right now. Picks are a plan. Wins are football. Play football.

columns.title: What to do with 11 first-round picks, by Holden McGroin
columns.dek: Bill_Buttlicker asked for my advice. He did not. I'm giving it anyway.
body: 1. Draft eleven kickers. This league doesn't start kickers, which means nobody else will have any. That's called market inefficiency.
2. Trade all eleven for Aaron Rodgers. He's 42, which is four times as old as the average first-round pick will be in their first season. Four times the experience.
3. Hold them forever. A pick can't get hurt, can't get benched, and can't score zero in your flex. Juwan Johnson can. Think about that.
4. Give one to Br0phy. He's 0-6 and already owns your 2027 first. It would be nice to keep them together.
5. Name your team after your picks. It worked for TJohn91 with The Champ. Try "Eleven Firsts and a Dream."

columns.title: Hold My DK is undefeated. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is better.
columns.dek: All-play, points for, and a 243.58 that should have won a trophy by itself.
body: Hold My DK is 6-0 with 950.24 points and a 51-15 all-play. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 5-1 with 970.94 points and a 52-14 all-play. By both measures, Catfan94 has the better team.

Expected wins from all-play: 51-15 is 4.6 expected wins for TheMoneyTeam2302, who has six. That's about 1.4 wins of good fortune, the most in the league. Catfan94's 52-14 is 4.7 expected wins, and he has five.
The close games tell the story. Hold My DK beat Asian Jim by 6.92 and Kraft for Cash by 3.86. Those go the other way about half the time.

Then there's 243.58, the highest score in league history, 45 points clear of second place. My model says LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is the favorite. My model has never seen a man start Aaron Rodgers in the superflex and win six straight, though.

exits.t: Scored 20.3 on the bench in Week 6 while Bill_Buttlicker started a flex who scored zero. Wants out of a team that has 11 firsts and no lineup.
Scored 24 on the bench in Week 6 while Pat Freiermuth started at tight end and scored 3.6. In a TE-premium league, no less.
Scored 28.1 on the bench in Week 6, more than any starter on the team. Fourth on the depth chart. He'd like a team where he's at least third.
Scored 22.1 on the bench in Week 6. Hold My DK won by 3.86 anyway, so nobody's listening.
Scored 25.2 in the flex for an 0-6 team. The best player on the field every week and still losing. He's asking around.
